process_area.title: Customer Safety Risk Strategy, Standards & Premises-Liability Framework

value_stream.name: Customer Safety, Premises Liability & In-Store Risk Management

fields.Owner: Head of Customer Safety / Risk (VS-21) / COO
fields.Participants: Risk (VS-21), Store Ops (VS-07), HSE (VS-24), Legal (VS-100), Insurance/BCP (VS-26), IFM (VS-138), Real Estate (VS-97)

fields.Volume: One enterprise customer-safety & premises-liability program across ~205 public sites

workflows.name: Customer Safety & Premises-Liability Strategy, Scope & Operating Model

Automation Opportunity: - Loss-history heat-mapping to priority sites/zones; auto-cascade of strategy to standards/zone design; KPI dashboarding
Controls: - CTL-671 (ensure controlled execution — Customer Safety Risk Strategy, Standards & Premises-Liability Framework (PA-147.1).)
- CTL-671: strategy approved by COO/Audit Committee; scope covers all customer zones; loss-history baseline established; reviewed annually (W4407)
Cross-references: - links to VS-21.2 (risk), VS-26 (insurance), VS-100 (legal), VS-138 (IFM), W4386 (standards), W4387 (liability), W4407 (audit)
Pain Points / Risks: - **Scope-blindness risk**: program covers only the sales floor while the lumber yard and parking lot (where the highest-severity incidents occur) drift; mitigated by full-zone scope and loss-history-driven prioritization
- **Strategy-execution gap**: strategy approved but never operationalized into standards; mitigated by mandatory cascade to W4386/W4389 and annual audit (W4407)
System Touchpoints: - Risk register (VS-21.2); incident-management system (W4392); insurance/claims (VS-26); legal-matter (VS-100); IFM CMMS (VS-138); BI (VS-28)
Time Estimate: - ~4–6 weeks annual strategy + on major-incident trigger

steps.a: COO / Head of Internal Audit & Risk
steps.activity: Risk/Customer Safety set the program strategy — scope (in-store, yard, parking, will-call, doorstep), objectives (zero fatalities, injury-rate target, claim-cost cap), and the prevention-by-design operating model

steps.a: Head of Customer Safety / Head of Internal Audit & Risk
steps.activity: Risk map the exposure landscape — premises-liability bodily injury, property damage, falling/shifted stock, powered-equipment contact, chemical exposure, crowd crush, parking — and the loss-history baseline
Risk document & approve the strategy, then cascade to standards (W4386), liability/insurance framework (W4387), governance (W4388), zone design (W4389), and the incident system (W4392)

fields.Participants: HSE (VS-24), Store Ops (VS-07), IFM (VS-138), Risk (VS-21.2), Insurance (VS-26)
fields.Volume: One customer-safety standards & hazard register; ~205 site risk assessments

workflows.name: Customer Safety Standards, Hazard Register & Risk Assessment

Automation Opportunity: - Hazard-library templates by zone/merchandise; risk-scoring engine; control-vs-hazard auto-link; mobile risk-assessment app
Controls: - CTL-671: hazard register maintained; risk-assessed per site; controls field-verified (W4393/W4407); reviewed on incident
Cross-references: - links to VS-24 (HSE), VS-138 (IFM), VS-63 (store task), W4385 (strategy), W4393 (inspection), W4406 (training), W4407 (audit)
Pain Points / Risks: - **Hazard-blindness risk**: undocumented hazard (e.g. unstable tile-stack height) → uncontrolled exposure; mitigated by mandatory register + per-merchandise-type hazard mapping
- **Control-effectiveness risk**: control specified but not field-verified → drift; mitigated by inspection (W4393) and audit (W4407)
System Touchpoints: - Hazard register & risk-assessment module (W4392); HSE (VS-24); IFM PM (VS-138); store-ops task (VS-63); BI (VS-28)
Time Estimate: - ~6–8 weeks annual; ~1 day per new-site assessment × ~205 sites

steps.activity: Customer Safety/HSE build the customer hazard register — slip/trip/fall, falling stock, shifted pallets, powered-equipment contact, chemical exposure, sharp/cut, parking, crowd, child — per zone and per merchandise type
Customer Safety conduct site risk assessments (likelihood × severity × exposure), define the mandatory control set per hazard (engineering/administrative/PPE/signage), and set inspection frequency
HSE/Store Ops publish the standards, train store teams (W4406), and review on incident learning (W4402) or change

fields.Participants: Insurance/BCP (VS-26), Legal (VS-100), Treasury (VS-18), Risk (VS-21), Customer Safety
fields.Trigger: Strategy (W4385); insurance renewal; claim; legal review

Automation Opportunity: - Coverage-vs-exposure modeling; auto-notification on incident; TPA-claim workflow; loss-run analytics
Controls: - CTL-671 (ensure controlled execution — Customer Safety Risk Strategy, Standards & Premises-Liability Framework (PA-147.1).)
- CTL-671: limits exposure-based & renewed; TPA-governed; 24-hr notification (W4405); loss-data fed to prevention
Cross-references: - links to VS-26 (insurance), VS-100 (legal), VS-18 (treasury), VS-21.2 (risk), W4385 (strategy), W4405 (notification)
Pain Points / Risks: - **Under-insurance risk**: inadequate limits/deductibles → uninsured loss; mitigated by annual exposure-based limit review
- **Late-notice risk**: claim reported late to insurer → coverage denied; mitigated by mandatory 24-hr notification protocol (W4405)
System Touchpoints: - Insurance policy/claims (VS-26); legal matter (VS-100); treasury (VS-18); risk register (VS-21.2); incident system (W4392)

steps.a: CFO / Head of Internal Audit & Risk / VP Legal
steps.activity: Insurance/Legal define the premises-liability coverage framework — CGL/public liability limits, deductibles, TPA arrangement, named-peril vs all-risk, and the additional-insured requirement for landlord/lessor sites

steps.a: CFO / Head of Internal Audit & Risk
steps.activity: Customer Safety/Insurance set the claims-handling protocol (notice, TPA liaison, reserve, settlement authority) and the loss-data feedback loop into prevention (W4385/W4386)
Legal set the litigation/defense framework (counsel panel, defense strategy, settlement authority, NLRC/court process) and the statutory-notification matrix (W4405)

fields.Participants: Risk (VS-21), Governance (VS-36), Store Ops (VS-07), HSE (VS-24), Legal (VS-100), Audit (VS-21)

Automation Opportunity: - RACI workflow with role-based task routing; accountability dashboard; exception/consequence tracking
Controls: - CTL-671: single program owner; first-line Store-Manager accountability; three-lines separation; Audit oversight (W4407)
Cross-references: - links to VS-36 (governance), VS-21 (audit/risk), VS-07 (store), VS-24 (HSE), W4407 (audit)
Pain Points / Risks: - **Accountability-vacuum risk**: "safety is everyone's job" → no one owns it; mitigated by single program owner + first-line Store-Manager accountability
- **Three-lines-blur risk**: second-line also performs first-line → assurance not independent; mitigated by clear three-lines separation & Audit oversight
System Touchpoints: - Governance (VS-36); risk (VS-21); audit (VS-21); store-ops (VS-07); HSE (VS-24); task/workflow (VS-63)

steps.activity: Customer Safety/Risk establish the governance structure — program owner, site accountability (Store Manager as first-line), second-line HSE/Risk assurance, third-line Audit, and Board/Audit-Committee oversight
Customer Safety publish the RACI — who inspects (store/HSE), who approves corrective action, who manages claims, who notifies regulators/insurers — across all sites and zones

steps.a: Audit Committee / Head of Internal Audit & Risk
steps.activity: Audit/Governance review accountability in practice (W4407), enforce consequence for non-compliance, and refresh on restructure

workflows.name: Customer Safety by Zone — Sales Floor, Yard, Lumber/Tile & Parking Design

Automation Opportunity: - Zone-design templates; safe-stacking standards library linked to planogram; mobile zone-setup checklist
Controls: - CTL-671 (ensure controlled execution — Customer Safety Risk Strategy, Standards & Premises-Liability Framework (PA-147.1).)
- CTL-671: zone designs approved; stacking standards enforced (W4394); pedestrian-equipment separation (W4395)
Cross-references: - links to VS-20/VS-97 (real estate), VS-55 (planogram), VS-138 (IFM), VS-109 (remodel), W4386 (standards), W4394 (stack), W4395 (equipment), W4396 (signage)
Pain Points / Risks: - **Pedestrian-equipment-conflict risk**: customers and forklifts sharing lumber/tile yard aisles → high-severity contact; mitigated by separated lanes, banking-hours-only equipment rules, and spotters (W4395)
- **Stack-collapse risk**: unstable cement/tile/lumber stacks → falling-stock injury; mitigated by height/restraint standards & inspection (W4394)
System Touchpoints: - Real estate/design (VS-20/VS-97); planogram/space (VS-55); IFM CMMS (VS-138); store-ops (VS-07); remodel (VS-109); hazard register (W4386)

steps.activity: Customer Safety/Real Estate design zone-specific safety: sales-floor (aisle width, clear-height, endcap stability, spill protocol); lumber/tile yard (separated pedestrian/forklift lanes, stacked-load height limits, banding); parking (lighting, crosswalks, cart corrals, speed)

steps.a: Head of Customer Safety / VP Merchandising
steps.activity: Merchandising/IFM specify safe stacking/pallet/racking & display standards (load, height, stability, restraint) per merchandise type (cement, tile, lumber, appliances) and embed in planogram (VS-55)
Store Ops/IFM implement the design (barriers, signage, line-marking, lighting), inspect on change, and feed learning into W4386/W4402

workflows.name: Contractor, Vendor & Third-Party On-Premises Safety Accountability

Automation Opportunity: - Third-party induction/badge kiosk; insurance/indemnity verification gate; equipment-zone geofencing; stop-work workflow
Controls: - CTL-671 (ensure controlled execution — Customer Safety Risk Strategy, Standards & Premises-Liability Framework (PA-147.1).)
- CTL-671: third-party safety terms in contract; induction mandatory; additional-insured/indemnity; stop-work authority
Cross-references: - links to VS-03 (vendor), VS-98 (contingent), VS-24 (HSE), VS-26 (insurance), VS-100 (legal), W4388 (RACI), W4395 (equipment)
Pain Points / Risks: - **Third-party-caused incident risk**: contractor/forklift injures customer → BuildRight still liable as premises occupier; mitigated by induction, indemnity, additional-insured, and stop-work authority
- **Untracked-presence risk**: unbilled/unbadged third party on floor → no accountability; mitigated by induction/badge gating (links VS-98)
System Touchpoints: - Vendor/contract (VS-03); contingent workforce (VS-98); store task (VS-63); HSE (VS-24); insurance (VS-26); legal (VS-100); incident (W4392)
Time Estimate: - ~15–30 min induction per third party; ongoing monitoring

steps.a: VP Legal / Head of Customer Safety
steps.activity: Vendor Mgmt/Legal set third-party on-premises safety terms — contractor safety induction, insurance/indemnity (additional-insured), equipment rules during trading hours, incident-reporting duty — in contracts

steps.a: Store Manager / Head of Customer Safety
steps.activity: Store Ops/Customer Safety induct & badge third parties (DSD drivers, remodel crews, promodizers, service vendors) on customer-safety rules, equipment-exclusion zones, and reporting

steps.a: Head of Customer Safety / VP Legal
steps.activity: Customer Safety/HSE monitor third-party adherence, stop unsafe work, and enforce consequence (contractual/insurance)

workflows.name: Customer Safety Compliance — Consumer Act, BFP Fire Code, OSH & Local Codes

Automation Opportunity: - Regulatory-change monitoring; compliance calendar auto-populated; self-audit checklist vs regulation; inspection-response workflow
Controls: - CTL-671: regulatory landscape mapped; standards/regulation-aligned; compliance calendar maintained; inspection-response ready
Cross-references: - links to VS-22 (compliance), VS-100 (legal), VS-76 (LGU), VS-24 (HSE), VS-138 (fire), W4386 (standards), W4399 (crowd), W4407 (audit)
Pain Points / Risks: - **Regulatory-blindness risk**: missed BFP assembly-occupancy or egress rule → fire/crowd hazard + penalty; mitigated by regulatory mapping & compliance calendar
- **Inspection-failure risk**: unprepared for inspection → fine/closure; mitigated by self-audit (W4407) ahead of regulatory inspection
System Touchpoints: - Compliance (VS-22); legal (VS-100); LGU (VS-76); HSE (VS-24); fire-system (VS-138); records (VS-88); standards (W4386)
Time Estimate: - ~3 weeks annual mapping; per-inspection response days

steps.a: VP Legal / Head of Customer Safety
steps.activity: Compliance/Legal map the customer-safety regulatory landscape — Consumer Act (RA 7394) premises/labeling, BFP Fire Code (RA 9514) egress/fire-load/assembly-occupancy, OSH customer-facing duties, LGU/local ordinances, and building-code accessibility (BP 344)
Customer Safety/HSE translate regulations into the standards (W4386) and zone design (W4389), and maintain the compliance calendar
Compliance/Legal manage inspections/audits by BFP/LGU/DTI/DOLE, respond to findings, and report to governance (W4388/W4407)

fields.Participants: IT (VS-27), EA (VS-113), BI (VS-28), Risk (VS-21), Privacy (VS-91), Legal (VS-100), HSE (VS-24)

workflows.name: Customer Safety Data, Incident System & Measurement Architecture

Automation Opportunity: - Mobile incident/near-miss app; CCTV/evidence auto-link; KPI dashboard; predictive hazard analytics (W4408)
Controls: - CTL-671 (ensure controlled execution — Customer Safety Risk Strategy, Standards & Premises-Liability Framework (PA-147.1).)
- CTL-671: architecture security-assessed (VS-27.3); PII minimized/secured (VS-91); CCTV-evidence retained per policy (VS-88); cost governed (VS-135)
Cross-references: - links to VS-27 (IT), VS-113 (EA), VS-28 (BI), VS-91 (privacy), VS-88 (records), VS-23.2 (CCTV), W4408 (analytics)
Pain Points / Risks: - **Under-reporting risk**: near-misses not captured → prevention signal lost; mitigated by easy mobile capture & no-blame near-miss culture
- **Privacy risk**: injured-customer PII/evidence exposed; mitigated by privacy-by-design (VS-91) & retention (VS-88)
System Touchpoints: - IT (VS-27); EA (VS-113); BI (VS-28); risk (VS-21); privacy (VS-91); records (VS-88); CCTV (VS-23.2); insurance (VS-26); TBM (VS-135)

steps.activity: Customer Safety/EA/IT design the incident-management & safety-data architecture — near-miss/incident capture (mobile), hazard register, inspection, corrective action, claims link (VS-26), and CCTV/video-evidence integration
IT/Privacy implement with PII minimization (injured-customer data), secure evidence store, retention (VS-88), and integration to Risk (VS-21), Legal (VS-100), Insurance (VS-26), BI (VS-28)
Customer Safety/BI govern the platform, drive analytics (W4408), and optimize on adoption/cost (VS-135)
